description: Remove duplicate elements from a sequence while preserving first-seen order, using dict.fromkeys as an order-preserving set. Pure and deterministic, with no library dependency (the dependency-free floor; a collections.OrderedDict- or pandas-based rewrite would add an import the floor does not need). The golden arg_sets cover the value-returning domain: the empty input, an all-unique list (nothing removed), an all-duplicate list (collapsed to one), a list whose duplicates are interleaved (pinning first-occurrence order), a string list, and a mix of adjacent and distant duplicates.
